sites.source: https://hellcreekrecreation.com/ ('There are 71 campsites, 44 of which have electrical hookups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Comfort station with showers; internet service (connection details on the office door). Fish-cleaning station, playground, trails, reservable group facility. Firewood, bait, groceries and gas at the private Hell Creek Marina.

facilities.source: https://hellcreekrecreation.com/ ('a comfort station, potable water, playground, trails, fish cleaning station, RV dump station and a group facility you can reserve') + Campspot Terms & Conditions ('keep the shower and restroom facilities tidy', 'We have internet service . See the office door for connection', 'Firewood is available for purchase at Hell Creek Marina'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked on Campspot (the 'Reservations' link on hellcreekrecreation.com). No more than 14 nights in any 30-day period. Check-in after 2 pm, check-out 12 pm. A $5 booking fee is kept on cancellation; no refund inside 7 days. Arrive by check-in the day after your arrival date or the booking becomes a no-show (call the manager at 406-557-2362 if late).

booking.source: https://hellcreekrecreation.com/ ('Reservations: https://www.campspot.com/book/hellcreek-recreationarea') + Campspot Terms & Conditions ('Campers may stay no longer than 14 nights in any thirty-day period', 'Check-in time is any time after 2 PM', 'Check-out time is 12 PM') and Cancellation Policy, read 2026-10-22

note: Former Hell Creek State Park, on Corps of Engineers land on the Hell Creek arm of Fort Peck Lake, about 25 miles north of Jordan; the operator says the drive from Jordan is about an hour on gravel road that varies with weather (call for conditions). The state handed its lease to the Little Shell Tribe of Chippewa Indians, which has run it since about 2022. 44 of the sites have electric hookups. Boat launch; a launching point for boat camping in the Missouri Breaks. --Claude
summary: Tribally operated (Little Shell Tribe) on USACE land, reservable on Campspot. Confirmed 71 sites, potable water, dump, Campspot booking; added showers, wifi, 14-night limit in 30 days, booking url. Fees ($35, read on Campspot 2026-10-13) left: no 2026/2027 availability is open to re-read. Not stated: season dates, site lengths, booking window (inherited 180 is a federal default that doesn't fit a Campspot park). Note trimmed of restated facilities.
flags: Campspot's park record still links its 'marketing site' to https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/hell-creek (the former state park page); the operator's site is https://hellcreekrecreation.com/ (already the entry's website).
